description: Boston, Massachusetts, 2-Dimensional Building Footprints with Height Data (from LIDAR data), 2002 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors 3Di Technologies, Inc.(Now Spectrum Mapping LLC), MassGIS (Office : Mass.). This dataset consists of 2D footprints of the buildings in the metropolitan Boston area, based on tiles in the orthoimage index (orthophoto quad ID: 229890, 229894, 229898, 229902, 233886, 233890, 233894, 233898, 233902, 237890, 237894, 237898, 237902, 241890, 241894, 241898, 241902, 245898, 245902). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: All materials, software, maps, studies, reports, and other products or data, regardless of physical form or characteristics, produced in furtherance o. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
